youtube_title: Hobart Branch Library: the ghost stories the library tells about itself (viewer request)
body: "Get out." You asked for Hobart! Lake County Public Library tells these stories about its own Hobart Branch. A janitor quit after hearing a voice tell her to get out. In the 1990s, after the workroom was repainted, staff found green slime covering the walls. Before opening, a staff member saw a white-haired woman in a black dress walking up a ramp, went after her, and she was gone. A branch head, locking up, looked back and saw a woman in a floor-length white dress. Rumor says a woman was murdered in a house later sold to the library, but the library says there are no official reports of a murder in newspapers of the time. It also says there have been no sightings since it stopped letting staff work alone. George Earle dammed Deep River in 1845, creating Lake George; he laid out Hobart in 1849 and named it for his brother. These are staff stories, told as stories. 👻 Comment your town, and it could be next! #Hobart #LakeCounty #NWI #Indiana #Haunted #LaPorteAfterDark
